sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'c') AND o.date >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-05-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c') AND o.date >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-12-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND ((CAST(strftime('%Y','2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) - (strftime('%m-%d','2026-09-25') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) = 25;
